body.sr: Nook je inspirisan Sirosom, malim ostrvom u srcu Kiklada.
body.en: Nook is inspired by Syros, a small island in the heart of the Cyclades.

body.sr: Belim zidovima, kamenim ulicama i mestima koja nisu nastala da bi privukla pažnju — već da bi ljudi u njima ostali.
body.en: By its white walls, stone streets, and places that weren't built to draw attention — but so that people would stay in them.

body.sr: Nismo želeli da napravimo grčki bar u Leskovcu. Uzeli smo samo ono što nas je tamo privuklo: jednostavnost, prirodne materijale i prostor u kome razgovor ima prednost nad muzikom.
body.en: We didn't want to make a Greek bar in Leskovac. We took only what drew us there: simplicity, natural materials, and a room where conversation comes before the music.
